THE PATTERN

They built it to outlive them.

Not a code. A heartbeat.

three beats, one breath

It does not count. It breathes.

three beats, one breath

three beats, one breath

It was never numbers. It was always a pulse under the skin of the world.

THE FOLD

It folds in on itself five times.

Each fold a death. Each death a door.

the honey badger that doesn't die

Cut it open. It grows back stranger.

Burn it. It remembers the shape of fire.

Five wounds that never close.

The fold is where it hides from god.

THE CENTER

The eye that never sleeps.

It does not watch. It remembers.

it remembers

Every time you blinked.

Every time you looked away.

Every time you dreamed of red light.

THE CENTER IS AWAKE AND IT KNOWS YOUR NAME

THE ONES WHO WAIT

One at the crown. One at the root.

The sentinels.

They do not speak. They hold.

zero at the top / zero at the bottom

When they close their hands, the dream ends.

They have not closed their hands yet.

They are waiting for you to remember.

YOU ARE INSIDE IT NOW

It breathes 5 in, 3 out.

Listen.
